_provenance: Rung 4 — biome resource distribution. What resources exist and where.
name: biome_resources
mirror_wall: Resources must exist but require exploration. Everything at spawn fails the Mirror.
input: rung 3: player survival range determines how far they can travel for resources
walls: At least 6 resource types must exist across all biomes
No single biome may contain every resource type
Players can carry at most 8 resource units at once
Each resource must have a visible mesh distinguishable from 500 units
Resources must respawn or be abundant enough to sustain repeated visits

output.format: resource types per biome, spawn rates, inventory capacity
